title: A customer created without AP/AR access gets the default COD and $0
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as {User-A}, on a custom role, {Role-A}, that has Customers → Create & Edit but not View and Manage AP/AR Data.
    For example: {User-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S5-17 User and {Role-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S5-17 No APAR.
  • COD is the shop's default for new customers.
  • A name for the new customer, {Customer-A}.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S5-17 Customer.
  • An Admin can check the result in a second browser.
  • Starting screen: the Customers page.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click "New Customer".
  2. Type {Customer-A} in Customer Name.
  3. Click Save.
  4. In the Admin's browser, open Edit Customer for {Customer-A}.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the "New Customer" window opens.
  • Step 2: the field shows the name as typed.
  • Step 3: the window closes and the new customer is saved.
  • Step 4: Credit Terms reads COD and the customer has a credit limit of $0.00.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11674 (Story 5, New Customer and Edit Customer)

  • S5-N4: “If the user does not have the 'View and Manage AP/AR Data' setting, the server ignores any term or limit sent with their save: a customer they create gets the shop's default term, with a $0 limit when the default is COD and no limit otherwise; a customer they edit keeps its stored term and limit.”
  • Key Decisions, Permissions: “A user without 'View and Manage AP/AR Data' who creates or edits a customer has any term or limit they send ignored by the server (S5-N4).”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Default Credit Terms" (https://claude.ai/artifact/2erYxWz2ffDNcoXzEfu6wf), read 23 Oct 2026: page "5 New Customer" ("New Customer without View and Manage AP/AR Data"). Compare the screen with the pictures below; the expected results above come from the PRD quotes.

  • ct-p5-05-new-customer-without-view-and-manage-ap-ar-data.png

The design's own words:

  • “No Credit Terms and no Credit Limit field. The customer is saved on the shop default without the user seeing it.”
